info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, radians, Ypos, loopX, loopWidth, door, cableGuy, distToGuyglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDList, gXVelChangeon beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  door = sprite(the currentSpriteNum - 1)  door.loc = this.loc  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  Xpos = float(this.locH)  this.locZ = 203  door.locZ = 50  cableGuy = sprite(6)endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset    if Xpos > loopX then      Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth    end if    if Xpos < -loopX then      Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth    end if    if (Xpos > 0) and (Xpos < 512) then      frontPoint = this.loc + point(80, 10)      backPoint = this.loc + point(-100, 10)      xDiff = float(frontPoint.locH - (cableGuy.locH + cableGuy.Xvel))      yDiff = float(frontPoint.locV - (cableGuy.locV + cableGuy.Yvel))      distToGuy = float(sqrt((xDiff * xDiff) + (yDiff * yDiff)))      toGuyVector = point(xDiff, yDiff)      if distToGuy < 80 then        if distToGuy <> 0 then          normToGuyVector = toGuyVector / distToGuy          pushVector = normToGuyVector * (80 - distToGuy)          cableGuy.Xvel = cableGuy.Xvel - pushVector.locH          cableGuy.Yvel = cableGuy.Yvel - pushVector.locV        end if      end if      xDiff = float(backPoint.locH - (cableGuy.locH + cableGuy.Xvel))      yDiff = float(backPoint.locV - (cableGuy.locV + cableGuy.Yvel))      distToGuy = float(sqrt((xDiff * xDiff) + (yDiff * yDiff)))      toGuyVector = point(xDiff, yDiff)      if distToGuy < 100 then        if distToGuy <> 0 then          normToGuyVector = toGuyVector / distToGuy          pushVector = normToGuyVector * (100 - distToGuy)          cableGuy.Xvel = cableGuy.Xvel - pushVector.locH          cableGuy.Yvel = cableGuy.Yvel - pushVector.locV        end if      end if      xDiff = float(this.locH - (cableGuy.locH + cableGuy.Xvel))      yDiff = float(this.locV - (cableGuy.locV + cableGuy.Yvel))      if abs(xDiff) < 30 then        if yDiff < 30 then          cableGuy.Yvel = cableGuy.Yvel - (30 - yDiff)        end if      end if    end if    this.locH = Xpos    door.loc = this.loc  end ifend
